text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, low total protein, elevated CRP, ferritin, INR, and mild monocytosis and basophilia, suggesting an ongoing inflammatory or infectious process. No evidence of acute myocardial injury or significant liver/renal dysfunction. Findings may be consistent with a systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or hypoxic injury. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
